item.title: Linux Distro Chooser
item.description:
Decide on the perfect Linux distro for you!

This is a simple Linux Distro Chooser tool that I created to help people find the perfect Linux distribution for their needs. It is based on my personal experience and recommendations.

Try it out!

Find the perfect Linux distribution for you!

Answer a few simple questions and get an answer, that's based on my experience and reccomendation.
